teaser: Agent sessions with a mandate, a role and a repository, paused and picked up again, so a team's knowledge outlives the team.
core_idea: When project teams dissolve, the knowledge needed to change their systems leaves with them; agent sessions focused on one mandate, role and repository can be paused and resumed with their record intact, as sessions on the sgit CLI and SG/Send did after 36 and 43 days, so a later fix can wake the team rather than rebuild its knowledge.
